engine_name: Decision engine rule catalogue version 1.3 (P3-02, FR3-17, NFR3-17): 23 rules (5 safety, 5 Today steps, 3 plan adjustments, 10 insights) with exact conditions, minimum data, minimum differences, cooldowns, safety checks and message templates; precedence safety > Today step > plan adjustment > insight; insights Premium, at most 3 per rolling 7 days and 1 per night, the same rule not repeated within 28 days (56 for habit praise); the low-mood safety rule R-SAFE-04 suppresses every non-safety insight and adjustment for 7 days, except the safety adjustment R-ADJ-03, which applies to every member with a calorie target and carries the gentle wording T-ADJ-03g during those days (version 1.1, Owner Q68); no AI. Version 1.2 (D3-58) adds section 9, the 36 Healthy Weight programme rules R-HW-SAFE-01 to -05, R-HW-NUM-01 to -05, R-HW-PACE-01, R-HW-STEP-01 to -06, R-HW-ALC-01, -02, R-HW-FOOD-01 to -03, R-HW-NOTE-01 to -05, R-HW-REM-01, R-HW-MOT-01, -02, R-HW-WEEK-01, -02, R-HW-BLOCK-01, -02 and R-HW-QOD-01, with their T-HW templates as worded in P3-02-Healthy-Weight-Templates.md; version 1.3 (D3-59) adds R-HW-BLOCK-03, which times the Festivals and fasting block so its week 3 starts on the festival's first day. The R-HW rules build and adjust the member's Healthy Weight plan: a programme class of their own, never counted in the insight quota; safety first (R-SAFE, the safety matrix, then R-HW-SAFE), then the signed Today steps, then numbers and pace (a gentler pace always wins), daily steps, food, notes, reminders, motivation, then weekly changes and focus blocks.
intended_use: Rule-based insights, Today steps, plan adjustments and safety notices for members, run once a night at 02:00 in the member's time zone and on demand after a profile change, a warning-level reading or opening Today. Every message is an owner-approved template in which the engine fills only numbers and dates; no template names a diagnosis or a medicine, none praises kilograms lost, and emails and notifications never carry an insight's text or numbers (NFR3-16, FR3-56 AS-02). The Healthy Weight programme rules (section 9) build each member's plan from their joining answers, check-ins and logs: the recommended pace, milestones, which approved step fills each day and in which version, the notes brought forward, the reminder times, the food filter and the focus block suggested from week 9; the engine fills only numbers, dates and names of approved items.
eligibility: Members with health consent and a profile. Safety rules run first for every member, Free and Premium, and always show. Insights and plan adjustments are Premium, except R-ADJ-03 (losing faster than the safe rate), a safety adjustment applied to every member with a calorie target, Free or Premium, never suppressed by R-SAFE-04; a member with an eating-disorder flag gets the raise with no message and no calorie number (version 1.1, Owner Q68). The safety matrix (P3-03) is evaluated before any rule and again at display time; the engine never fires a rule the matrix forbids for that member, and a rule never fires below its minimum data. Healthy Weight programme rules run only for members on Healthy Weight, which is never offered in pregnancy or breastfeeding, with an eating disorder, or under 18 (R-HW-SAFE-01); "prefer not to say" on the eating-disorder question limits the pace to 0.25 or 0.5 kg a week. Safety, the numbers, pace, milestones, the reason on Today and the food-rule and allergy filter are free; personalised step order and versions, extra steps, notes brought forward, food preferences and focus block suggestions are Premium (rule question 12). When R-SAFE-04 fires, every R-HW rule except R-HW-SAFE and the calorie target pauses for 7 days.
sources: ISH 2020 home BP thresholds and the >= 5 mmHg meaningful difference; Stergiou 2021 (home protocol).
NICE CG189 (weight-loss rate, plateaus); Hall 2011; P3-56 for the cap.
AASM/SRS 2015 sleep duration consensus; Grandner MA et al. Sleep 2010 (short sleep and hypertension).
WHO 2020 physical activity guidelines (150-300 min moderate); Chekroud SR et al. Lancet Psychiatry 2018 (activity and mood, dose about 45 min, 3-5 times a week).
Ross R et al. Waist circumference as a vital sign. Nat Rev Endocrinol 2020 (waist vs weight).
SACN 2015 (fibre 30 g); Stage 1 protein tool for protein targets.
ADA Standards of Care 2025 (glucose levels); FR2-38 wording for self-harm response.

P3-35 Where-you-are-now method sheet (signed 6 Nov 2026, D3-54 to D3-57): Healthy Weight Check engine (FR2-39, AS-19), one pictured drink 130 kcal, card above 8 a week or 5 or more a time; NHS calories in alcohol; UK CMO and NHMRC drinking guidelines; WHO Europe 2023.
P3-55 Daily Calorie Target and P3-56 Goal Weight Timeline method sheets (signed 3 Nov 2026).
NICE NG246 (2025): health benefits from about 5 % weight loss, greater at 10 % (milestone wording).
limitations: R-SAFE-02 (glucose warning levels) is applied at save time with the safety matrix Part C wording, not nightly; it has no template of its own in the catalogue and no test data there.
R-STEP-01 has a pregnancy wording variant T-STEP-01p ('share it with your midwife') whose text is not written out in the catalogue.
R-STEP-03, R-STEP-05, R-INS-07, R-INS-09 and R-INS-10 have no should-fire / should-not-fire test data in the catalogue.
Deliberately absent: a water-intake rule and any glucose-pattern rule (I-12: no glucose interpretation beyond the warning levels).
An insight already shown is not withdrawn when its data is later edited.

Message wording is drafted jointly with the content session's safety/stage3-messages.md (P3-77); where the two differ, the catalogue's template IDs are the ones the engine uses and the content file is aligned to them before approval.

Healthy Weight programme rules: the action library, mindset notes, track activities, sleep, stress and alcohol steps and the festival calendar are approved content passed in by the caller; the engine never writes member-facing text of its own.
R-HW-BLOCK-03 day map: a calendar move is applied from the day after it is made; a step already shown is never shown again.

Readings of the signed text where it was silent are listed in includes/stage3/healthy-weight/README.md (exercise minutes after the 10-minute cap, strength sessions, where an extra step goes when day 6 is taken, focus-block weeks rounded to the nearest week).
regulatory_statement: Signed off by the owner as clinical reviewer on 3 November 2026 (D3-43 to D3-48; version 1.1 with D3-49 the same day), version 1.2 on 6 November 2026 (D3-58, the Healthy Weight programme rules and templates) and version 1.3 on 10 November 2026 (D3-59, R-HW-BLOCK-03); record Signoff-P3-02-Decision-Engine-Rule-Catalogue.md. General health information, not a diagnosis or a medical device. Frozen: any change needs a new decision and a new version (NFR3-14, NFR3-17).

Version 1: Signed 3 November 2026 ('Approve all, D3-10 = B', in chat with the clinical session). D3-43 the 23 rules and templates as drafted; D3-44 Skip after a low-mood day does not lower the weekly ring that week; D3-45 plateau never lowers calories, offers a logging focus and a meal-plan swap; D3-46 too fast: calorie target raised by 250 kcal automatically, member told, doctor line if the 7-day rule triggered; D3-47 sleep vs BP: >= 5 mmHg systolic difference, >= 14 paired days with >= 4 short (< 6 h) and >= 4 long (>= 7 h) nights, 42-day window; D3-48 run at 02:00 local nightly plus on demand after profile changes and warning-level readings. Quota 3 insights per rolling 7 days, 1 per night, 28-day cooldown (56 for habit praise); R-SAFE-04 suppresses all non-safety insights and adjustments for 7 days.
